homonyms.basis: No homonym on the rail: both cards are Arena's. The census record carries no disambiguation, negative_tags or battery for this row (checked: census.json rows[slug == 'search-arena'] has none of the three keys). In the field the name 'Search Arena' names two aspects of one entity, the platform and leaderboard (B3, B1) and the dataset of its battles (B4: 'we introduce Search Arena, a crowd-sourced … human-preference dataset'); the MMRS record holds them as one entity, the leaderboard with its dataset paper, and the row does the same. Distinct entities kept distinct: Arena's other arenas and their boards (Text, the former Chatbot Arena; WebDev; Agent; Image Edit; B2's snippet), each a board of the same operator; Arena itself, the operator (B8); the dataset search-arena-24k as a released artefact (B4's link); other 'arenas' found by WebSearch on 2026-10-29 and on no card, Design Arena (designarena.ai) and SWE-Arena (huggingface.co/datasets/SWE-Arena).
